tooltip.gunwood.spray_brush.summary: Hold Shift for spray brush details.
tooltip.gunwood.spray_brush.detail.2: Painted blocks are hidden and skipped by renderers.
tooltip.gunwood.spray_brush.detail.3: Right-click a block to paint it when no selection is active.
tooltip.gunwood.spray_brush.detail.5: Paints the active Gunwood selection in bulk.
tooltip.gunwood.spray_brush.detail.6: Consumes durability once per successful use, including batch operations.
tooltip.gunwood.spray_brush.flavor: Despite being called a spray brush, it is actually more like a stick.
tooltip.gunwood.scraper.detail.2: Right-click a painted block to scrape it when no selection is active.
tooltip.gunwood.scraper.detail.4: Scrapes the active Gunwood selection in bulk.
tooltip.gunwood.scraper.detail.5: Held scrapers show nearby painted blocks and the current selection.
tooltip.gunwood.scraper.detail.6: Consumes durability once per successful use, including batch operations.
tooltip.gunwood.glasses.detail.1: Wear to see blocks hidden by transparent paint.
tooltip.gunwood.glasses.detail.2: Supports the Curios head slot when Curios is installed.
tooltip.gunwood.glasses.detail.3: Only changes whether painted blocks are visible.
tooltip.gunwood.glasses.detail.4: Does not affect painted block light propagation.
tooltip.gunwood.paint_selector.summary: Hold Shift for paint selector details.
tooltip.gunwood.paint_selector.detail.2: Right-click blocks to set the selection start and end.
tooltip.gunwood.paint_selector.detail.3: Hold Ctrl and scroll while looking at a selection face to adjust it.
tooltip.gunwood.paint_selector.detail.4: Shift right-click to clear the selection.
tooltip.gunwood.paint_selector.detail.5: Hold to show the selection outline and nearby painted blocks.
tooltip.gunwood.paint_selector.detail.6: The selection helps spray brushes and scrapers work in bulk.
